boundary: CPU world-space actual cape and skinned torso/head triangles. Floor vertices, edge midpoints and centroids are sampled: exact floor lower bound on flat/linear slope, sampled bound on nonlinear real terrain. Body intersections count proper segment/triangle crossings, not coplanar or containment classification. Negative reference normal dot means rotation beyond 90 degrees, not automatically inversion. No WebGL/device/perceptual performance claim.
